reason: Based on repository name, README, and package metadata, this plugin is primarily for managing persistent agent instructions by editing a single local global AGENTS.md file through a DeepSeek Harness Web settings page, with features like default document creation, atomic writes, revision checks, and size limiting; this indicates a memory/context utility rather than a broader automation, search, or code-generation tool.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 的设置界面提供“全局记忆”页面，可直接编辑 `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`，用于管理面向跨项目长期生效的开发指令和偏好。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a Global Memory page to DeepSeek Harness settings so users can edit `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md` in-browser for reusable development instructions and preferences.

capabilities: Read and edit the local `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md` file
Persist edited instructions via web-based settings interface
Enforce revision-based concurrency checks and size limits on saved content

reasons.code: Readme states the plugin edits the global AGENTS.md file directly from DeepSeek Harness Web settings and saves content to `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`.
The plugin description and README specify local-only behavior and fixed target path for AGENTS.md with no configurable file path input from the browser.
Package metadata declares a DSH web client plugin bundle and platform integration, confirming execution inside the DeepSeek Harness Web plugin system.
